data.long_description:
Luxurious 2-Bedroom Apartment | Address Sky View Tower | Downtown Dubai

Property Details:

Bedrooms: 2
Bathrooms: 3
BUA: 1,329.02 sq.ft
Fully Furnished
High Floor | Burj Khalifa View
1 Allocated Parking Space

Experience luxury living at its finest in this stunning 2-bedroom apartment located in the iconic Address Sky View Tower, Downtown Dubai. Spanning over 1,329 sq.ft, this elegantly furnished residence features floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the space with natural light and offer breathtaking views of the Burj Khalifa and Downtown skyline.

The apartment boasts a spacious open-plan living and dining area, a fully fitted modern kitchen with premium appliances, and two generously sized en-suite bedrooms. Residents can enjoy three luxurious bathrooms finished to the highest standards, as well as a private balcony perfect for relaxing and taking in the panoramic city views.

Building Features:

5-star Address Hotel amenities
Infinity swimming pool overlooking Burj Khalifa
Fully equipped fitness center & spa
24-hour concierge and security
Direct access to Dubai Mall and Metro Link Bridge
Housekeeping and laundry services available

Location:

Situated in the heart of Downtown Dubai, Address Sky View offers an unmatched lifestyle with world-class dining, shopping, and entertainment just steps away. Perfect for professionals or families seeking upscale urban living in one of Dubai’s most prestigious addresses.
